layers.name: Hardware/Architecture Layer
layers.description: Direct hardware interaction, ARMv7-A architecture support, and low-level drivers (GIC, Timer, Exceptions).

layers.name: Kernel Core Layer
layers.description: OS kernel primitives: round-robin scheduling, thread management, and synchronization.

layers.name: Runtime Support Layer
layers.description: Minimal C runtime and ARM EABI helpers for bare-metal execution.

layers.name: Application/Service Layer
layers.description: Llama2 inference engine featuring NEON acceleration and high-level LLM control logic.

layers.name: Initialization Layer
layers.description: Main entry point that orchestrates the boot process and initializes other layers.
